source.title: Polynomial time approximation algorithms for machine scheduling: ten open problems

needs_review.question_text_raw: The resolver metadata states that the paper discusses 10 open questions, but the exact paper full text could not be recovered as a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source. A related TU Eindhoven thesis was recoverable, but it is a different work and only highlights four of the paper's ten open problems.

evidence.quote: We discuss what we consider to be the 10 most vexing open questions in the area of polynomial time approximation algorithms for NP-hard deterministic machine scheduling problems. We summarize what is known on these problems, we discuss related results, and we provide pointers to the literature.

Schuurman & Woeginger [1999b] discuss the ten, in their opinion, most interesting open problems in the area. In this next-to-last section we highlight some of those problems. We have selected the following four problems:
